scripts.dev: npm run generate && bash scripts/fetch_theme.sh && cd content && myst start
scripts.check: uv run python scripts/check_all.py && uv run codespell content docs templates && uv run pytest tests -q
scripts.ast: npm run generate && bash scripts/fetch_theme.sh && cd content && myst build --site --ci
scripts.verify: npm run ast && uv run python scripts/extract_answers.py content/_build/site/content -o verify/_answers.json && uv run pytest verify -q && uv run python scripts/check_coverage.py
scripts.all: npm run check && npm run verify && npm run test:widgets && npm run build
